english.title: Produce false document or information to secure payment of NHS charge to which not entitled
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) produced

(A)_[a document]_
(B)_[information]_

which you knew to be false in a material particular, namely **(..SPECIFY FALSE PARTICULAR..), with a view to securing for

(C)_[yourself]_
(D)_[another, namely **(..SPECIFY PERSON..),]_

a payment under the National Health Service Act 2006 in respect of the cost of obtaining

(E)_[goods]_
(F)_[services]_

to which section 192 of that Act applied, namely **(..SPECIFY GOODS OR SERVICES..), where

(G)_[you were not]_
(H)_[that person was not]_

entitled to, or to the benefit of, the payment
english.legislation: Contrary to section 194(1)(c), (2)(b) and (3) of the National Health Service Act 2006.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
produce false document / information
with view to securing for self / other
payment under Act in respect of the cost of obtaining goods / services to which s192 applied
when you / the other was not entitled to / the benefit of the payment
